tasks.short: Signal coworkers when equipment action is needed or cooking is complete.

steps.what: Check actual cooking status and whether the next equipment operation is ready
Identify the actual coworker responsible for the next equipment operation
Formulate and check the exact equipment or completion signal for that coworker
Notify or signal the coworker to operate equipment or recognise processing completion

tasks.design: Retain the actual status check, recipient selection and checked signal on the cooking floor. Examine existing {OPS_SYSTEM} cooker status indicators and native completion signals first; their existing runtime removes no additional human work, and a timer cannot establish that a coworker can safely start the next operation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The status must be tied to the actual batch and physical handoff.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing indicators can show equipment status; no new change is established for this local signal.
tasks.still_hard: Readiness, line noise and the coworkers actual position determine whether the handoff works.
tasks.human_edge: The operator checks real conditions and addresses the correct worker.
tasks.altitude: No change in decision rights or the operators week is established.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: cooking equipment commonly has status indicators, but an existing indication is not a new labour saving or proof of a safe handoff.

assumptions: Boundary is the operators actual notification action. The recipients equipment operation and any separate batch completion record are different work; no record-writing saving is claimed.
The equipment produces actual status and the operator checks it in s1. No structured readiness flag, digital worker-location feed or uncounted input capture is assumed.
The message preparation and actual delivery are split explicitly. Checking the intended cue in s3 is ordinary signal formulation, not a new approval ceremony.
No document write exists in this spoken or physical signal scenario. If the actual site uses a written handoff, its capture and send must be measured before claiming a change; none is assumed here.
Shares are provisional. Existing native indicator and signal settings are checked first and earn no saving. Zero incremental upkeep is justified because no new mechanism is introduced.
unknowns: Whether the site uses spoken signals, a light or written handoffs
Whether native signals already cover completion
research_questions: Observe whether any actual written handoff or avoidable recipient search occurs before proposing automation.

incremental.description: No new mechanism or ongoing upkeep

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact checked equipment or completion signal and actual coworker recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Status checking, recipient selection, cue preparation and actual notification all retain full effort. No existing indicator runtime or unobserved written handoff is banked as saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Actual cooking-floor coordination and its authority stay unchanged.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish equipment completion indications from safe handoff readiness
role.ambitious_version: No expanded role is established by this signal task.

job.title: Food Cooking Machine Operators and Tenders
